// NOTE: Main annotation format — produced by generate_annotations.py (phase 5) then enriched by refine_touch_masks.py.

// FIELDS.image_path: Absolute path to the JPEG frame (in data/epic_kitchen/frames/{video_id}/).
// FIELDS.hand_mask_path: Absolute path to the hand segmentation mask ({stem}_p{n}_hand.png).
// FIELDS.object_mask_path: Absolute path to the object segmentation mask ({stem}_p{n}_object.png).
// FIELDS.target_path: Absolute path to the original touch mask ({stem}_p{n}_touch.png). Legacy field name kept for compatibility.
// FIELDS.touch_mask_path: Same as target_path — normalised field name added by refine_touch_masks.py.
// FIELDS.object_name: Name of the object being interacted with. Empty string or null for no-touch entries.
// FIELDS.frame_idx: Integer frame number extracted from the filename (e.g. P01_05_frame_0000009754 → 9754). Added by generate_annotations.py.
// FIELDS.audio_timestamp_sec: Time of the frame within the video in seconds = frame_idx / 50 (EK100 is 50 fps). Added by generate_annotations.py.
// FIELDS.audio_path: Absolute path to the per-video AAC audio track (data/epic_kitchen/audio/{video_id}.aac). Empty string if not yet downloaded (run phase 6). Added by generate_annotations.py when --audio_root is set.
// FIELDS.depth_path: Absolute path to the uint16 grayscale depth PNG ({stem}_p{n}_depth.png). Reload: np.array(Image.open(p)).astype(np.float32) / 65535. Added by refine_touch_masks.py.
// FIELDS.// refined mask: The refined touch mask ({stem}_p{n}_touch_refined.png) is written alongside the other masks but is not yet a tracked annotation field.
